description: center board connector escapes, PCIe fanouts and pair tuning limits

suites.scope: NVMe data and reference clock copper coupling
notes: Limits are fixed local ceilings, not a whole-net allowance. Geometry outside every local window still has to follow nominal coupling.
Maximum nearest-copper distance uses a conservative sampling error bound. Uncoupled lengths are exact analytical capsule coverage.
Paired 45-degree corners are accepted only when both offset legs are independently verified.
The 25 nm corner recognizer covers retained 20 nm inward rounding. It does not increase the 2 nm outside maximum tolerance.
A region is selected by net stem and layer. It cannot waive a neighboring pair or a width, clearance, drill or plane violation.

suites.scope: Wi-Fi PCIe data and reference clock

regions.name: wifi source clock F right vias
wifi source clock In2 right vias
wifi source clock F resistor vias
wifi source clock In2 resistor vias

notes: All limits apply to clipped geometry for exactly one pair and copper layer.
Outside these local windows, the full traces and arcs retain nominal coupling.
Arc centers follow native KiCad geometry; per-arc center rounding is measured and bounded, never applied to straight-to-straight spacing.
Native DRC still checks every physical clearance, minimum gap, drill, width and layer condition.

GBE_HOST_TX FPC103 lands to staggered vias

notes: These are the existing pad-to-via escapes. The long board-to-board interfaces remain unrouted.
Every centerline is clipped to the exact local window. Copper outside all windows stays at nominal coupling.
No minimum gap, width, clearance, via drill or ground-plane restriction is waived.
The fixed ceilings include at most 0.016 mm of length margin and 0.006 mm of sampled-gap upper-bound margin over this reviewed geometry.

suites.scope: Existing center USB connector escapes; complete interfaces remain unrouted
notes: Only the existing pad-to-via copper is present. Passing these coupling limits does not establish complete USB connectivity or length matching.
FPC102 and FPC103 tracks keep the approved 0.1796 mm width and 0.2032 mm coupled gap. The fanouts preserve their pad contacts and fixed 0.6 mm vias.

Every line and arc is clipped to each local region. Full copper outside the regions must remain coupled. Length and distance ceilings allow only the measured local transition plus at most 0.005 mm margin.
No native minimum gap, clearance, width, hole-spacing or layer rule is waived.
